profile.title: Principal Technical Member of Staff Engineer
profile.summary: As an experienced Software Engineer, I specialize in creating and maintaining interactive web applications using modern technologies like React.js, TypeScript, and Next.js. My strong understanding of optimization techniques, UI modernization, and team leadership allows me to enhance application performance, drive automation, and deliver a positive impact on company results.
profile.tagline: Building scalable, high-performance health and enterprise applications for millions of users
profile.bio: Principal Technical Member of Staff Engineer at Oracle Health (Cerner) with 15+ years of experience building enterprise-scale applications. Previously at ESPN and American Express, where I developed features for 1M+ daily users and led multiple engineering teams. Passionate about modernization, automation, mentoring developers, and delivering exceptional user experiences.
highlights: Leading UI modernization and automation at Oracle Health (Cerner)
Led development for ESPN.com sportsbook features
Built React components serving 1M+ daily users at American Express
Improved dashboard load time by 4 seconds through optimization
Mentored 10+ engineers resulting in multiple promotions
